descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Enter the fifth dimension of golf! Developed with The R&A, DP World Tour, and Me and My Golf, Golf 5 takes your swing to the next level.
With High Precision Control (HPC©), every shot is captured with millimetric accuracy in an ultra-realistic and immersive HD environment.
Perfect for all levels: from beginners learning the game to players perfecting their technique or simply having fun.
Play solo, against AI, or online with friends around the world. Compete in international tournaments, earn G5 coins, and climb the official International eGolf Federation ranking.
🔥 New Modes:
🤝 Online Team Modes: team up in Scramble or Fourball formats.
⚡ Flash 3 Holes: fast, exciting 3-hole matches, solo or online.
🎮 Instant presets for VR accessories: set up your gear in seconds.
⛳ Included Content:
🌴 4 free courses: Dunes, Forest, Tropical, and Safari (3 pin positions each).
🌍 7 premium DLC courses: Royal County Down, Royal Troon (host of the 152nd Open), Hoylake, Royal Portrush, Old Course - St Andrews, Sunningdale, and Valderrama. More coming soon!
🎯 Additional Features:
• 🏆 Match, Stroke, or Stableford
• 🏌️‍♀️ Driving Range
• 🎯 Putting Green
• ⏱️ WiPp – fast and fun mode
• 🌀 Minigolf
• 📈 XTi© Pro Launch Manager
🧩 Also Includes:
🛒 2 free Callaway sets + 3 extras
🛩 Drone View
🍃 Dynamic Wind
🌍 Multilingual
👥 3D Avatars, Multiplayer Mode & Mobile App
Get ready to experience the most realistic and thrilling golf ever in VR.
